data.one_liner: A Flutter widget for adding soft inner shadows to containers for neumorphic designs.
data.what_it_does: InnerShadowContainer is a customizable Flutter widget that renders inner shadows on containers and other UI elements. It supports independently configuring shadow directions, blur radii, offsets, and colors to help achieve a soft neumorphic design style.
use_when: You want to build a neumorphic UI style with soft inner container shadows.
You need a lightweight, dependency-free widget to apply inset shadows in Flutter.
avoid_when: You need complex standard drop shadows instead of inner/inset shadows.
Your design system does not utilize neumorphic styling.
strengths: Fine-grained control over individual corner and side shadow directions.
weaknesses: Limited to inner shadow container styling rather than general-purpose graphic design tools.
Only applies to container-like shapes provided by the widget.
data.minimal_example:
InnerShadowContainer(
  height: 120,
  width: 120,
  backgroundColor: Colors.white,
  borderRadius: 20,
  blur: 6,
  offset: Offset(4, 4),
  shadowColor: Colors.black26,
  isShadowTopLeft: true,
  isShadowBottomRight: true,
  child: Center(
    child: Icon(Icons.star, size: 40, color: Colors.orange),
  ),
);
